manifest.source: Independent Euler–Bernoulli solid-cantilever approximation; uy_tip=-F*L^3/(3*E*I), sigma_xx=F*(L-x)*(y-h/2)/I; I=b*h^3/12. Timoshenko shear contribution F*L/(kappa*G*A) is 0.6% of EB with kappa=5/6 and nu=0; a disclosed approximation, not cross-solver evidence.
manifest.geometry: Synthetic rectangular solid 0<=x<=1, 0<=y,z<=0.1 m; length/aspect ratio 10
manifest.supports: All translations fixed on complete immutable x=0 face
manifest.loads: Total global force (0,-1,0) N uniformly spread once over complete x=1 face with quadratic consistent integration
manifest.samples: Area-weighted mean native DAT uy on complete x=1 face; raw IP sigma_xx with 0.25<=x<=0.75, abs(y-0.05)>=0.02, 0.02<=z<=0.08; at least four stress samples per mesh
manifest.exclusions: Root and loaded-face end effects, neutral-axis relative stress, side-edge samples and peak singularities excluded by fixed physical sample regions before execution. No shell/beam elements or claimed solid peak accuracy.
manifest.reason: docs/VALIDATION.md proposed 2% slender-cantilever displacement and 5% non-root stress criteria; nu=0 avoids added Poisson clamping disturbance while disclosed shear correction is below displacement budget
